Track KPIs consistently, maintain data accuracy, and share performance openly, reinforcing a culture of transparency and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or related field 3+ years of professional experience in field marketing, including content, communications, technical writing, engineering, IT, data center, or related technical fields. Demonstrated experience managing event logistics and post-event lead processes. Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Oracle, Redwood) and marketing automation platforms (e.g., 6Sense, PowerBi, social media scheduling tools, budgeting & expense platforms) Experience using Canva Pro Excellent written and verbal English Willingness to travel regularly within the UK, Ireland, and the Nordics (up to 3 months per year) and attend face-to-face meetings at our London or Southampton office on a regular basis. Desired Profile Strong interest in and understanding technology and digital infrastructure markets. Ability to quickly learn and communicate complex technical subjects. Ability to manage multiple projects and navigate structured review and approval processes. Experience in B2B technology marketing, engineering, IT, data center, or related industries preferred. Familiarity of working for large US corporates Proven PR experience and event management skills. Skills & Competencies End-to-end event delivery and logistics management Lead management mastery, CRM routing, qualification, and follow-up frameworks. Proven ability to interface with multiple stakeholders at all levels, both face-to-face and via remote/virtual channels Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and managing multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience working within or alongside Revenue PODs or cross-functional commercial teams. PR coordination and narrative development for regional media and industry audiences Brand enforcement with a keen eye for visual and messaging consistency Social media content development and performance monitoring across B2B platforms Clear, compelling copywriting for case studies, sales enablement, and event collateral Cross-functional collaboration with sales teams, agencies, and internal stakeholders Marketing analytics and pipeline reporting Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered content creation, research, productivity, and workflow automation tools to improve efficiency and enhance output quality. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. About Us The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion. OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES High-Performance Culture Customer Focus Operational Excellence Innovation Financial Strength VERTIV BEHAVIORS Own it Act with urgency Foster a customer-first mindset Think big and execute Lead by example Drive continuous improvement Learn and seek out development Promote transparent & open communication About Vertiv Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. new_matches.title: OpenShift Technical Account Manager
new_matches.description: The Red Hat services team is looking for an experienced System administrator engineer to join us as a Red Hat OpenShift Technical Account Manager. In this role, you will provide adoption guidance, implementation of good practices and supportable insights to customers for the Red Hat OpenShift and Infrastructure solutions portfolio. Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are highly technical and experienced engineers who work with customers on their strategic needs and mission-critical environments. As part of the services organization, the TAM works on behalf of the customer as their advocate with engineering. TAM works proactively to prevent incidents. When a problem occurs, the TAM will work with the customer to resolve the incident by coordinating efforts within Red Hat. TAM aims to support the development, deployment, and support teams, ensuring that the best practices for configuration, tuning, and use of Red Hat products are applied. You will act proactively, with a critical eye on the customer environment providing information and insights to facilitate the adoption of the technologies, keeping the environment supported, understanding customer objectives and priorities increasing customer loyalty, understanding IT infrastructure, internal processes and business needs, facilitating collaboration with other vendors and advocating for customers. What you will do Support enterprise customers implementing automated and containerized cloud application platform solutions Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become a guide on a customer's implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities. Help customers achieve their business goals and outcomes by providing recommendations that will benefit customers' ongoing usage of Red Hat’s technologies. Attain Trusted Advisor status with both key business and technical decision makers. Lead Technical Health Reviews and provide relevant technical recommendations on solutions and enhancements specific to customers' business needs. In support of the Customer Success Strategy and Success Manager, monitor and identify trends in Red Hat adoption and utilization, Success Plan adoption and utilization, providing guidance as part of Quarterly Success reviews. Proactive liaison and focal point into Red Hat Technology and Product teams and Technical Support Team, to address product feature/technical hurdles. Provide proactive Communications in the event of a service degradation or disruption. Participate in issues and act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases, driving business reliability and customer satisfaction. Provide executive level summary status reports both internally and to the customer for all high severity cases. Collaborate with internal teams to improve customer satisfaction and reduce renewal risk. Foster existing unused product capabilities/functionality that could help customer's business. Serve as the customer advocate within Red Hat Travel regionally to visit customers occasionally What you will bring 5+ years of experience in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (OpenShift by Red Hat), containers and Kubernetes Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region Good comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology-related discipline, ideally computer science or engineering Experience working in DevOps environments About Red Hat Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. Inclusion at Red Hat Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. new_matches.title: Senior Project Manager
new_matches.description: What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. How you’ll demonstrate Ownership At Cognite, we're transforming the world's most asset-intensive industries through Industrial AI. Our customers rely on us to turn complex industrial data into meaningful business outcomes—and this is where you come in. We're looking for a Project Manager who enjoys solving complex challenges, takes ownership of outcomes, and is motivated by delivering measurable value. This role goes beyond managing timelines; you'll lead transformational AI implementation projects that help some of the world's largest industrial organisations modernise the way they operate. From contract signing through deployment and value realisation, you'll partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver successful projects that create lasting business impact. The Impact you bring to Cognite As the Project Manager, you'll be accountable for the successful delivery of complex Industrial AI implementation projects by: Leading end-to-end project delivery from kickoff through deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Owning project scope, schedule, budget, quality, customer outcomes, and commercial performance. Collaborating with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality solutions. Translating customer objectives into measurable success metrics and facilitating Value Realisation Workshops to demonstrate business impact. Managing project financials, including forecasting, revenue recognition, profitability, cost management, and reporting. Building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, and providing clear communication throughout the project lifecycle. Identifying and managing risks, dependencies, and scope changes while ensuring appropriate governance and transparency. Supporting customer adoption through change management, enablement, and training while recognising opportunities to expand customer value. Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices by applying Cognite's PMO methodologies, playbooks, and lessons learned. Required Qualifications A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of experience delivering complex software, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology implementation projects. Experience managing enterprise or industrial digital transformation programmes involving multiple stakeholders and technical workstreams. Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architecture, and enterprise systems, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams and informed decision-making. Strong commercial and financial acumen, including forecasting, revenue recognition, margin management, and project profitability. Experience within one or more industrial sectors, including Energy, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Utilities, Power & Renewables, or Life Sciences. Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and project governance frameworks such as Scrum, PMP, or PRINCE2. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently across technical teams, customers, and executive stakeholders. Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet. Willingness to travel up to 25% as required. Preferred Skills We're particularly interested if you also bring experience in: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification. Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Industrial IoT, SCADA, MES, or Operational Technology (OT) environments. AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or Analytics implementation projects. Why Cognite? At Cognite, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve complex, real-world challenges. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-moving environment where innovation, curiosity, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value diverse perspectives and believe great ideas come from people with different experiences and backgrounds. If you're excited by technology, enjoy working with customers to solve meaningful problems, and want to help shape the future of industry, we'd love to hear from you. Learn More About Us Impact 2025 Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi. Equal Opportunity Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

new_matches.title: Hardware System Test Engineer
new_matches.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain system-level hardware defect detection tests for individual servers and rack-based systems. Implement tests to detect assembly defects, marginal components, damaged hardware, cabling or interconnect issues, cooling faults, etc. Develop service and field diagnostic tests used for RMA triage, repair validation, and preventative maintenance. Implement deterministic, fast-running tests with clear pass/fail criteria and actionable failure output suitable for manufacturing and service technicians. Develop PCIe defect detection tests to identify lane faults, link degradation, polarity issues, retimer problems, and intermittent connectivity failures. Implement stress and soak tests designed to expose latent or marginal hardware issues. Debug test failures and hardware issues, performing root-cause analysis and escalating design or process issues as appropriate. Analyze factory and field failure data to identify coverage gaps and propose test improvements. Support deployment, versioning, and maintenance of test software across factory and service environments. Collaborate with software development teams to integrate tests into production system software. Collaborate with hardware, manufacturing, service, and reliability teams to ensure tests align with known defect modes and operational needs. Required Qualifications 3–7 years of experience in system, server, or hardware test engineering, preferably in manufacturing or service environments. Solid understanding of server hardware architectures, PCIe fabrics, power delivery, cooling systems, and common failure modes. Hands-on experience developing or executing hardware defect detection or diagnostic tests. Experience working in Linux-based test environments. Familiarity with BMC-based systems and basic use of OpenBMC or Redfish interfaces. Strong debug skills and the ability to distinguish test issues from real hardware faults. Ability to write clear test code, logs, and documentation for operational use. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI accelerator, GPU, or high-performance compute servers. Exposure to PCIe Gen4/5/6 systems or other high-speed serial interconnects. Experience diagnosing intermittent, marginal, or temperature-dependent hardware failures. Experience working with liquid-cooled or thermally complex server platforms. An award-winning workplace You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. With platforms in Detection and Measurement and HVAC, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world. As part of Detection and Measurement, TCI is a global leader in innovative spectrum monitoring and communications intelligence (COMINT) systems. With solutions to ensure the efficient use of frequencies, long distance communications, monitoring and security communications intelligence applications, we improve communications and protect military forces and infrastructure around the world. How You Will Make An Impact (Job Summary) SPX is a diverse team of unique individuals who all make an impact. The Regional Sales Manager – APAC will be responsible for driving revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic account development across APAC. The role focuses on government, defense, and security customers, managing complex sales cycles and positioning TCI solutions (COMIN, C-UAS, EW, etc.) as mission-critical capabilities. This role requires a hunter mindset, deep regional relationships, and the ability to win complex defense programs in highly competitive environments. Identify customer needs and wants and utilize this information to identify best value solutions which successfully meet the customer requirements, schedule and budget; Deliver and accomplish aggressive goals for meeting new decision-makers with current and new client organizations, and interact with all levels of client management The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, deep regional knowledge, and a proven track record of delivering results in complex multicultural markets. What You Can Expect In This Role (Job Responsibilities) While each day brings new opportunities to SPX, your core responsibilities will be: Revenue Growth & Sales Delivery Meet sales quotas for defined opportunities and oversee the maintenance of COMINT contact, prospect, and target databases (Salesforce), providing monthly and quarterly updates of key sales metrics. Monitor and analyze COMINT regional sales activities against plan, developing and implementing strategies to achieve stretch goals. Build pipeline and manage full sales lifecycle from lead to contract closure. Lead COMINT sales activities in APAC to identify, manage, and expand new accounts; serve as capture manager when needed to close contracts and as product owner to guide solution development and enhancement. Develop and execute sales strategies for communication intelligence (COMINT) that align with organizational sales objectives and market trends. Market Expansion & Strategic Growth Identify and penetrate new markets across Eastern APAC, Balkans, and NATO countries. Meet decision-makers within current and new client organizations to pursue strategic opportunities and champion COMINT product offerings. Monitor industry developments and regulatory changes for new business opportunities. Drive product innovation by collecting market trends and competitive intelligence, soliciting input from international representatives, potential and existing customers, and translating insights into actionable product improvements. Collaborate with Sales director to develop and update annual operating and strategic growth plans for the COMINT product line, including bookings forecasts. Customer & Key Account Management Build and maintain relationships with key customers, partners, and industry stakeholders. Build strong relationships with Ministries of Defense, intelligence agencies, and system integrators. Manage key accounts and develop long-term strategic partnerships. Act as a trusted advisor to customers, understanding operational needs and translating them into solutions. Promote positive relations with customers, employees, partners, vendors, and distributors. Sales Execution & Capture Management Participate actively in the capture process for strategic COMINT opportunities, including capture planning, strategy development, customer site visits, and contract negotiations. Assist in RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and contract negotiations. Navigate government procurement processes and compliance requirements. Support demos, trials, and field deployments. Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and webinars as a sales executive. Solution Development & Technical Positioning Position TCI solutions through consultative and technical selling approach. Translate customer operational requirements into integrated system solutions. Assist the COMINT product team in identifying customer needs and requirements, delivering best-value solutions that meet schedules and budgets while ensuring products remain competitive and relevant. Experience applying technology solutions to complex business problems including costing of proposed solutions. Channel, Internal & Cross-Functional Coordination Manage all sales channel efforts in APAC, including a global direct sales force, independent commissioned sales representatives, and select distributors. Coordinate internally across engineering, product, and delivery teams. What we are looking for (Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education) We each bring something to the table, and we are looking for someone who has: Required Experience Extensive experience selling complex, large-scale enterprise solutions, managing sales cycles from months to 18 months, multi-million-dollar tenders. Established track record in a sales position with recent experience in COMINT or Spectrum Monitoring & Management sales is a plus. Experience with foreign government contract negotiations in a commercial business environment. Proven success selling complex, large-scale enterprise solutions and managing long sales cycles, including multi-million-dollar tenders. Ability to quickly grasp highly technical concepts and communicate their benefits to customers. Strong understanding of APAC markets and proven success in achieving revenue targets. Experience managing remote sales channels and international sales representatives. Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Exceptional organizational and time management abilities. Demonstrated ability to lead and facilitate group meetings. Multiple language skills are highly desirable. Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and growth. Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, compelling sales messages. Result-oriented, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Strong negotiation and influencing skills. Commitment to customer success and long-term partnerships. new_matches.title: Regional Payroll Lead - Greater Asia, Food Ingredients
new_matches.description: Job Summary IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers. What's your next big career move? If it involves helping build and stabilize payroll operations across one of the most complex and fast-growing regions in the world, we should talk. The Regional Payroll Lead, Greater Asia will lead the execution, implementation, and stabilization of payroll operations across the Greater Asia region as the Food Ingredients business transitions to a standalone organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Payroll , this role is responsible for translating global payroll strategy into local execution across the region, ensuring payroll readiness, implementation success, operational compliance, and service delivery excellence across multiple countries. Working closely with ADP, TMF, local payroll resources, and key regional stakeholders, this leader will oversee payroll delivery, vendor performance, compliance, controls, and issue resolution while supporting the successful stand-up of a new global payroll organization. The Regional Payroll Lead will lead regional payroll resources and serve as the primary point of accountability for payroll performance and service delivery across Greater Asia. In this role you will play a critical role in supporting the Food Ingredients business as it transitions to a standalone organization. This role will lead payroll implementation, vendor coordination, service delivery, and operational readiness activities across the region. With the global payroll strategy and vendor model already established, this leader will be responsible for ensuring successful regional execution—driving country readiness activities, supporting payroll implementations, managing vendors, overseeing local payroll resources, and ensuring a compliant and stable payroll operation across all countries within the region. This role requires strong multi-country payroll expertise, vendor management capability, stakeholder partnership, and the ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving transformation environment. Following implementation, the role will continue to lead payroll operations across the region while driving service excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement. The preferred location for the role would be Kunshan, China but other locations within China can be considered as well. Where You'll Make a Difference Lead the execution, implementation, and stabilization of payroll operations across the Greater Asia region as the Food Ingredients business transitions to a standalone organization. Own regional payroll delivery against the global payroll project plan, ensuring country readiness activities, testing, risks, dependencies, and implementation milestones are actively managed. Drive payroll readiness and successful transition activities across all countries within scope, partnering closely with global payroll leadership, vendors, and regional stakeholders. Support transition from implementation to steady-state operations while helping establish a scalable, compliant, and future-ready payroll function. Oversee end-to-end payroll operations across the region, ensuring payroll is accurate, timely, compliant, and delivered in accordance with country-specific requirements. Lead and develop regional payroll resources, providing direction, coaching, and support to local payroll teams while ensuring consistent service delivery and operational execution. Manage day-to-day relationships with payroll vendors, including ADP and TMF, ensuring service levels, contractual commitments, and country-specific requirements are met. Act as the primary escalation point for regional payroll issues, coordinating resolution across vendors, local teams, and internal stakeholders. Partner closely with HR, Finance, Tax, Legal, Controllership, and business leaders to ensure alignment on payroll inputs, outputs, funding, reporting, and compliance requirements. Support the implementation and maintenance of payroll controls, governance processes, standard operating procedures, and audit requirements. Monitor payroll performance metrics, vendor performance, compliance risks, and operational effectiveness, driving continuous improvement across the region. What Makes You The Right Fit Extensive payroll experience with significant multi-country Asia-Pacific payroll leadership responsibilities. Strong experience managing payroll operations across multiple countries, including oversight of payroll vendors and local payroll teams. Demonstrated experience supporting payroll implementations, transitions, or transformation initiatives within complex multinational organizations. Strong understanding of payroll compliance, controls, governance, statutory requirements, and country-specific payroll practices across Asia-Pacific markets. Experience supporting payroll operations across diverse regulatory environments, including collective bargaining agreements, labor unions, employee representative bodies, and country-specific employment frameworks throughout Asia-Pacific markets. Experience managing vendor-led payroll delivery models and driving vendor accountability against service levels and operational performance expectations. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, risks, and operational activities in a fast-paced environment. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across HR, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and business leadership. Experience leading teams, coaching payroll professionals, and creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement. Strong communication in English and Mandarin, as well as problem-solving, execution, and organizational skills. How Would You Stand Out? Prior experience working with ADP, TMF, or similar global payroll providers. Experience leading payroll stand-up, carve-out, separation, or transformation activities. Experience operating within a shared services, global business services, or outsourced payroll environment and experience within a manufacturing, industrial, food, ingredients, or similarly complex operational environment. Why Choose Us? Be part of a meaningful business transformation with global reach and impact. Play a key role in building and stabilizing payroll operations across a diverse and growing region. Work closely with global payroll leadership and senior stakeholders to shape a future-state payroll organization. Lead regional teams and vendor partnerships while driving operational excellence and service delivery. Join a purpose-driven organization focused on innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. Your potential is our inspiration. Important Information Regarding This Position For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability. Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

new_matches.description: Stillstand? Gibt es bei uns nicht! Als dynamisch wachsendes Unternehmen mit eigener Kosmetikproduktion bauen wir unser Geschäft weiter aus und erweitern aktuell unser Sortiment um Nahrungsergänzungsmittel. Odoo ist dabei das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens: Vom ersten Produktionsschritt über den Versand bis zur Buchhaltung läuft bei uns alles über dieses System. Damit das auch künftig reibungslos funktioniert, suchen wir jemanden, der Odoo mit uns weiterentwickelt. Vielleicht dich? Aufgaben Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen entwickeln: Du programmierst eigenständig individuelle Odoo-Module und passt das System exakt an unsere Bedürfnisse an. Schnittstellenmanagement: Du konzipierst und implementierst stabile APIs und Schnittstellen zur Anbindung externer Tools an unsere Odoo-Landschaft. Prozess- & Ablaufoptimierung: Du analysierst unsere bestehenden Workflows, findest Flaschenhälse und digitalisierst bzw. automatisierst sie direkt in Odoo. Systemseitige Skalierung: Du begleitest technisch unsere Erweiterung von der Kosmetik- auf die Nahrungsmittelproduktion und bildest die neuen Produktionsprozesse in Odoo ab. Fokus Support & Logistik: Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachabteilungen zusammen, um die Prozesse im Customer Support, QM, Produktentwicklung bzw. Produktion und in der Logistik strategisch mitzuentwickeln und systemseitig umzusetzen. Unterstützung beim Aufbau skalierbarer IT- und Prozessstrukturen Qualitätssicherung & Dokumentation: Du testest deine Entwicklungen auf Herz und Nieren, hältst den Code sauber und dokumentierst die Anpassungen für das Team. new_matches.title: Senior Software Engineer — Platform & Distributed Systems (XTM Foundation)
new_matches.description: 🌀 The Company Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture. Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and platform engineering to join the XTM Foundation team — Filigran's cross-product engineering team responsible for architecture, quality, shared tooling, and technical standards across the XTM Suite (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC). You will be the technical owner of our most ambitious infrastructure challenge: designing the architecture evolution to increase data processing capacity. You will define the patterns and standards that govern how our products communicate, scale, and evolve — working closely with product engineering teams to turn architectural vision into reality. This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You won't just design on paper — you'll prototype, benchmark, validate, and help teams implement. You'll bring rigor and pragmatism to some of the hardest technical problems in our roadmap. 💼 Your Responsibilities Lead the design and implementation of architecture evolution, targeting significant improvement in data processing throughput and scalability. Identify and resolve bottlenecks across the current data pipeline (ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis) through rigorous profiling, benchmarking, and architectural analysis. Evaluate and recommend infrastructure and messaging technologies, alternative graph databases, CQRS/event sourcing patterns, and validate them through hands-on prototyping. Define and enforce cross-product standards for inter-service communication, data consistency, and system observability. Build performance testing infrastructure from the ground up — establishing continuous performance monitoring as a first-class engineering practice across the XTM Suite. Collaborate with product engineering teams (~60 engineers) to roll out architectural changes progressively and safely, with zero-downtime migrations where possible. Contribute to the XTM Foundation team's broader mission: shared libraries, common patterns, and platform-level tooling that raise the bar for all product teams. Stay current with the distributed systems and data engineering landscape, bringing well-evaluated proposals to the team. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: VP of Technology. Key collaborators: Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, evaluation, prototyping) and embedded collaboration with product teams to implement and validate changes in real-world conditions. 🧬 Profile We're Looking For 8–12 years of experience building and operating distributed, high-throughput systems in production environments. Proven track record designing architectures for data-intensive platforms (data pipelines, event-driven systems, graph databases, or equivalent). Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, partitioning, replication, backpressure, fault tolerance, and observability. Broad knowledge of backend languages and ecosystems — you've worked with multiple languages and paradigms, and you know how to pick the right tool for the job. Deep familiarity with data storage and messaging technologies — you have hands-on experience with a range of databases (relational, search, graph, columnar) and message brokers, and you understand the trade-offs between them. Ability to build performance benchmarks from scratch and translate results into clear architectural decisions. Excellent system design and written communication skills — you can turn complex tradeoffs into actionable proposals that engineers and leadership can act on. Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English. Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive problems to resolution without waiting for direction, and you enable others rather than becoming a bottleneck. 🏗️ About XTM Foundation XTM Foundation is Filigran's cross-product engineering team, created to raise the technical bar across the entire XTM Suite. The team owns the problems that no single product team can solve alone: shared architecture, inter-product communication standards, common UI components, CI/CD infrastructure, test quality, developer experience, and AI-assisted development practices. XTM Foundation engineers work closely with all product teams — not as gatekeepers, but as force multipliers. They bring deep expertise, evaluate new approaches before rolling them out at scale, and help 60+ engineers build better software, faster. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster. ⭐ What we believe We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative. 💻 How we work We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter. 🧭 What guides us We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 Compensation & Benefits Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.
